title: Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell Young people are angry at capitalism, but Natalie Brunell says they blame the wrong target. She explains how Bitcoin can fix a rigged bank-fiat system. This post Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mark Mason .
